capabilities: show daily notes from the same date in previous years
show weekly notes from previous years with the same week number
link past notes from the associated daily or weekly note
disambiguation: Not a journaling or prompt-writing tool; it only surfaces existing daily and weekly notes from previous years.
extras: The README is short and asks users to report issues or dissatisfaction via GitHub issues.
problem: Obsidian's daily and weekly notes don't surface notes from the same date in previous years, so reviewing past entries requires manual searching.

relations.evidence: Be sure you have the Periodic Notes Plugin installed and configured correctly.

summary: Shows daily and weekly notes from the same date or week number in past years while viewing today's daily or weekly note.
